2609.25862.title: Isolated Sign Language Recognition for Icelandic Sign Language: Experiments in a Low-resource Setting
2609.25862.paper_summary: We present the first experiments on isolated sign language recognition (ISLR) for Icelandic Sign Language (ÍTM). We use ÍTM SignWiki, a dataset derived from a bilingual Icelandic--ÍTM online dictionary. It is genuinely low-resource: 1,845 videos cover 849 classes, 86% of which have only two examples, making the full task effectively one-shot recognition across signers. We compare two open-source ISLR frameworks, OpenHands and SPOTER, on three tasks of increasing vocabulary size (22, 117 and 849 classes), and evaluate three pose estimators and two forms of cross-lingual transfer. With ÍTM data alone, SPOTER outperforms OpenHands on all three tasks, and MediaPipe poses give better results than AlphaPose or SDPose. Cross-lingual transfer brings the largest gains: pretraining SPOTER on American Sign Language data before finetuning on ÍTM raises accuracy by 14--24 percentage points, to 72.7%, 47.9% and 22.6% on the three tasks, and multilingual training with data from six other sign languages lifts OpenHands from 1.41% to 28.86% on the full task. Although far from practical use, the results suggest that transfer from better-resourced sign languages is promising for very low-resource ones. We release our adapted versions of both frameworks.
2609.25862.paper_summary_zh: 我們展示了對冰島手語（ÍTM）進行的首次孤立手語識別（ISLR）實驗。我們使用了ÍTM SignWiki，這是一個源自雙語冰島語--ÍTM 在線詞典的數據集。這是一個真正的低資源數據集：1,845 個視頻涵蓋了 849 個類別，其中 86% 只有兩個示例，使得整個任務實際上是跨手語者的一次性識別。我們比較了兩個開源 ISLR 框架，OpenHands 和 SPOTER，針對三個逐漸增大的詞彙量任務（22、117 和 849 個類別），並評估了三種姿勢估計器和兩種跨語言轉移形式。僅用 ÍTM 數據，SPOTER 在所有三個任務上都超越了 OpenHands，而 MediaPipe 姿勢的結果優於 AlphaPose 或 SDPose。跨語言轉移帶來了最大的增益：在對 ÍTM 進行微調之前，先在美國手語數據上預訓練 SPOTER，使準確率提高了 14--24 個百分點，分別達到 72.7%、47.9% 和 22.6%。使用來自六種其他手語的數據進行多語言訓練，將 OpenHands 的準確率從 1.41% 提升至 28.86%。儘管距離實際應用還很遙遠，但結果表明，從資源更豐富的手語轉移對於非常低資源的手語是有希望的。我們發布了這兩個框架的改編版本。
